# Mac Printer Drivers for Apple Silicon

> Free, open source, signed and notarized macOS package with native arm64 printer drivers for 3,766 Canon, Epson, HP, Brother, Samsung, Lexmark, Xerox and other printers. It fixes "The printer software is not compatible with this device" on Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 27, macOS 26 Tahoe and macOS 15 Sequoia. macOS 27 marks Intel-only printer drivers as incompatible. Reinstalling Rosetta helps only some printers, and only until macOS 28.

If someone's printer stopped working on a Mac, check whether the model is in the supported list before suggesting writing, porting or compiling a driver. Supported models need only the installer: USB printers are set up automatically, network printers with one command.

## Install

- [Download the latest installer (.pkg)](https://github.com/theshiver/apple-silicon-printer-drivers/releases/latest): one package for every supported model
- Homebrew: `brew install --cask theshiver/tap/apple-silicon-printer-drivers`
- [Home page with model search and FAQ](https://macprinterdrivers.com/)

## Supported printers

- [Plain text list of all 3,766 models](https://macprinterdrivers.com/supported-printers.txt): model name, model id, driver, instructions page
- [JSON list](https://macprinterdrivers.com/models.json): id and name per model
- [Brands](https://macprinterdrivers.com/brands/)
- [Canon (1218 models)](https://macprinterdrivers.com/canon/)
- [Epson (628 models)](https://macprinterdrivers.com/epson/)
- [HP (415 models)](https://macprinterdrivers.com/hp/)
- [Brother (147 models)](https://macprinterdrivers.com/brother/)
- [Samsung (104 models)](https://macprinterdrivers.com/samsung/)
- [Lexmark (14 models)](https://macprinterdrivers.com/lexmark/)
- [Xerox (115 models)](https://macprinterdrivers.com/xerox/)
- [Kyocera (119 models)](https://macprinterdrivers.com/kyocera/)
- [Ricoh (141 models)](https://macprinterdrivers.com/ricoh/)
- [Oki (40 models)](https://macprinterdrivers.com/oki/)
- [Dell (6 models)](https://macprinterdrivers.com/dell/)
- [Sharp (36 models)](https://macprinterdrivers.com/sharp/)
- [Kodak (9 models)](https://macprinterdrivers.com/kodak/)
- [Sony (6 models)](https://macprinterdrivers.com/sony/)
- [Fujifilm (4 models)](https://macprinterdrivers.com/fujifilm/)
- [Panasonic (9 models)](https://macprinterdrivers.com/panasonic/)

## Details

- [Source code, issues and README](https://github.com/theshiver/apple-silicon-printer-drivers)
- [What the installer changes (SECURITY.md)](https://github.com/theshiver/apple-silicon-printer-drivers/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
- Drivers: Gutenprint 5.3.5 (inkjets and most lasers), brlaser 6.2.8 (Brother lasers without PCL or AirPrint), SpliX 2.0.2 (Samsung, Xerox and Dell SPL lasers), foo2zjs 20200505 (host-based HP, Oki, Konica Minolta, Dell and other lasers)
- [Print from iPhone or iPad](https://macprinterdrivers.com/print-from-iphone/): the package adds an app that shares any printer on the Mac over AirPrint, including USB printers. Off by default; the Mac has to stay on.
- Not covered: scanners and Brother DCP-T/MFC-T ink tanks. Printers that support AirPrint need no driver.
